relay.brief: Imperial troops are closing on the Temple’s outer gate. Hold the approach for 6 turns while the guard seals the breach.
relay.goal: Hold the Temple’s outer gate for 6 turns.
relay.win: The gate held. The Temple guard seals the breach.
relay.lose: The outer gate fell. The Temple is exposed.
relay.quote: “Hold the gate. The Temple needs time.” — Grand Master Zym

envoy.brief: A Republic envoy is leaking the peace-talk schedule. Scan his data terminals (Jedi or Medic, adjacent). Once 2 are copied, anyone who reaches an evac zone gets the data out. Capture him if you can.
envoy.goal: Scan 2 of 3 terminals, then get anyone to an evac zone. Threat rises after turn 6: terminals get wiped, and at Threat 6 the trail goes cold.
envoy.win: The data is out. The Council reads it that night.
envoy.quote: “Somebody is selling the peace. Find out who.” — Kao Cen Darach

blockade.brief: Mandalorian clans in Imperial pay are hitting a Republic supply convoy. Hold the depot for 8 turns until the Navy escort arrives.
blockade.goal: Hold the convoy for 8 turns. Mandalorians are armored and hit hard.
blockade.win: The escort arrives. The convoy gets through.
blockade.lose: The convoy burns. The lane stays closed.

cache.brief: An Imperial listening post is tracking Republic fleet moves. Scan its terminals (Jedi or Medic, adjacent), then get anyone to an evac zone.
cache.goal: Scan 2 of 3 terminals, then get anyone to an evac zone. Threat rises after turn 6.
cache.win: The intercepts are out. The Navy changes course.
cache.lose: The post wipes itself. The trail goes cold.

hutt.brief: The Hutt broker keeps his kyber deals on warehouse terminals. Copy the ledgers and get out. His Mandalorian guards will not make it easy.
hutt.goal: Scan 2 of 3 terminals, then get anyone to an evac zone. Threat rises after turn 6.
hutt.win: The ledgers are out, and so are his crystals.

dock.near: Malgus is at the lift doors. Next turn he is inside.
dock.push: Malgus pushes toward the Temple lifts.
dock.brief: While the treaty is signed on Alderaan, Darth Malgus lands at Docking Ring Nine with a strike team. His target is the Temple. Stop him here.
dock.goal: Defeat Darth Malgus. Threat rises after the par turn; at Threat 6 he reaches the Temple lifts. Barrels (x) explode when shot.
dock.win: Malgus falls on the docking ring. The Temple never sees him.
dock.lose: Malgus breaks through to the Temple.
dock.quote: “This is the vision. Change it.” — Grand Master Zym

vault.brief: You start concealed: pods patrol the ruins. Master Gnost-Dural found a sealed vault in the Ossus ruins: records from the last time the Sith struck at the Jedi. Imperial agents found it too. Scan the terminals (Jedi or Medic, adjacent), then reach evac.
vault.goal: Scan 2 of 3 terminals, then get anyone to an evac zone. A Sith Acolyte guards the vault. Threat rises after turn 6.
vault.win: The records come home. Gnost-Dural reads all night.
vault.lose: The vault burns. Whatever it knew is ash.
vault.quote: “The last time the Sith struck at a Temple, they did it while we talked.” — Gnost-Dural

ilum.brief: Sith raiders want the Ilum crystal caves. Sgt. Jace Malcom’s platoon is all that holds the mouth, and it is thin. Hold for 8 turns until his relief lands.
ilum.goal: Hold the cave mouth for 8 turns. Three waves; the last brings a Sith Acolyte.
ilum.win: Relief lands in the snow. The caves stay quiet.
ilum.lose: The raiders reach the crystals. Ilum goes dark for a generation.
ilum.quote: “No Jedi blade without Ilum. Hold it.” — Grand Master Zym

adraasHunt.escape: Adraas reaches his shuttle and is gone.
adraasHunt.near: Adraas is at his shuttle ramp.
adraasHunt.push: Adraas falls back toward his shuttle.
adraasHunt.brief: You start concealed. While the delegates talk, Lord Adraas waits in an embassy hangar for a signal. Satele Shan wants him taken off the board before it comes. Defeat him before he reaches his shuttle.
adraasHunt.goal: Defeat Lord Adraas. Threat rises after turn 6; at Threat 6 he escapes. Barrels (x) explode when shot.
adraasHunt.win: Adraas falls in the hangar. One blade fewer for the strike.
adraasHunt.lose: Adraas gets away. He will be at Malgus’s side.
adraasHunt.quote: “Two of them will come. Let us make it one.” — Satele Shan

taris.brief: Sith raiders grabbed a Republic relief officer from a Taris refugee camp. Open the cell (Hack or console), then walk her to an evac zone (E).
taris.goal: Open the cell (Hack or console), then get the prisoner to an evac zone. Threat rises after turn 5; at Threat 6 they fly the prisoner out.
taris.win: The officer is out. The camp gets its medicine.
taris.lose: The officer is gone. The camp goes hungry.

thul.brief: Imperial agents want a young heir of House Thul dead before the talks. Walk her to the shuttle at the far evac zone.
thul.goal: Walk the VIP to an evac zone. Threat rises after turn 6: more hunters arrive and they shoot the VIP on sight.
thul.win: The heir reaches the talks. House Thul owes the Order.
thul.lose: The heir dies on her own lawn. Alderaan blames the Jedi.

depot.brief: The Empire fuels its Balmorra fleet from this depot. Plant charges on 2 sites (anyone, adjacent, 1 action), then get every standing squad member onto the far evac zone. The charges blow when you are clear.
depot.goal: Plant 2 charges (adjacent, 1 action), then get everyone still standing onto the north evac zone. Threat rises after turn 7: techs defuse an armed charge each step.
depot.win: The depot burns. The Imperial push stalls a month.
depot.lose: The depot holds. The push comes on time.

fort.brief: A Republic hill fort on Ord Mantell is under Mandalorian and Sith attack. Hold it for 6 turns until the garrison regroups.
fort.goal: Hold the fort for 6 turns. Mandalorians are armored and hit hard.
fort.win: The garrison regroups. The hill stays Republic.
fort.lose: The fort falls. Ord Mantell burns again.

blockade.text: Clans in Imperial pay are choking a Republic supply lane. The Navy asks for Jedi.

cache.text: A Sentinel sensed Imperial slicers in an old Republic post. Something is tracking the fleet.

hutt.text: A Hutt is selling Ilum-grade crystals to anyone. His ledgers name the buyers.

taris.text: Raiders took the relief officer who keeps a refugee camp alive.

thul.text: An Alderaanian heir is marked for death before the peace talks.

depot.text: An Imperial depot feeds the next push. Blow it and get out.

fort.text: Mandalorians and Sith troopers are storming a Republic hill fort.

EVENTS.text: Master Gnost-Dural asks to copy the Archives to a hidden colony, in case the Temple falls.
A Hutt broker has Ilum-grade crystals. His price: look away from his spice run.
Mandalorians in Imperial pay are choking a supply lane. The Navy asks for Jedi. The Senate asks you to stay out.
You know the strike is coming. Warn the Senate, and maybe the Empire's spies, or keep it inside the Order?
A young Knight, Satele Shan, asks to join your strike teams. Her master, Kao Cen Darach, disagrees.
A captured Imperial officer offers names of Republic traitors in exchange for a ship.
Refugees from Taris ask to camp in the Temple gardens. The Senate says it sets a bad example.
A Senate committee wants an account of every credit the Order spends on the war.
A Republic sergeant, Jace Malcom, sends a blunt signal from Ilum: Sith scouts are circling the crystal caves.
An Imperial agent wants to defect. She says she knows how the Empire talks to its strike teams.
Gnost-Dural’s records show the old Sith struck at a Temple during peace talks. He thinks it will happen again.
A Mandalorian champion holds a Republic pilot. He will trade her for a duel with your best Jedi.
A young Jedi lost friends in the last fight. They want the next mission to be about payback.
Satele Shan and Jace Malcom are seen together more than the Code would like. Darach asks you to step in.
Grand Master Zym will back the treaty, even its terms that pull Jedi off Imperial-claimed worlds.
Scouts saw a Twi’lek, Eleena Daru, buying shuttle codes for Coruscant. She travels with Darth Malgus.
The Temple Guard captain asks for credits to post guards at the Coruscant docking rings.
A Padawan asks why the Order makes peace with the people who burned their homeworld.
The Hutt from Act I is back. He wants your help with a Senate hearing, or he sells what he knows about the docking rings to the Empire.
The hidden Archive copy sends word: the keepers found a holocron the Temple thought was lost.
One name from the Imperial officer’s list now runs docking control on Coruscant.
A Taris refugee you sheltered years ago is now a freighter pilot. She saw a Sith shuttle filing false papers for Coruscant.
The Mandalorian champion you dueled sends a fighter. "You beat him clean. Clan Ordo pays its debts."

FLAG_LINES.e1_strike_known: The envoy talked: you knew the strike was coming.
FLAG_LINES.e1_ambush_ready: You kept the warning inside the Order and set an ambush.
FLAG_LINES.archive_backup: A copy of the Archives sleeps on a hidden colony.
FLAG_LINES.e1_traitors: Names of Republic traitors sit in your files.
FLAG_LINES.boss_or_won: Darth Malgus fell at Docking Ring Nine.
FLAG_LINES.temple_scarred: The Temple was scarred. In canon it was sacked.
FLAG_LINES.jace_joined: Jace Malcom fought for the Order.
FLAG_LINES.satele_joined: Satele Shan fought under your command.
FLAG_LINES.e1_adraas_free: Lord Adraas escaped to join the strike.
FLAG_LINES.e1_opposed_treaty: You spoke against the treaty’s terms.
FLAG_LINES.e1_eleena_tracked: You tracked Eleena Daru to Malgus’s shuttle.
FLAG_LINES.e1_docks_guarded: Temple Guards watched the docking rings.
FLAG_LINES.e1_hutt_sold: A Hutt sold the docking schedule to the Empire.
FLAG_LINES.e1_refugees_in: You sheltered Taris refugees in the Temple gardens.
FLAG_LINES.e1_mando_honor: A Jedi beat a Mandalorian champion in a fair duel.

relay.win: Three of them didn’t come home to the frontier.
relay.lose: The fleet arrived to a burned-out relay.

envoy.win: Saresh will never serve the Senate again. Nobody thanks you for it.

rescue.win: The depot burns behind you. So does the trust of the local militia.

shrine.win: The pilgrims light candles for the Jedi. And for the troopers who held the line.
shrine.lose: The crystals are gone. The shrine will sing no more.

archive.win: The Navy got its codes. Imperial Intelligence will want to know who took them.

sabotage.win: The sky over Balmorra burns orange for a week.

escort.win: The senator will vote for peace. He will not thank you either.

blockade.win: The convoy is through. The clans will remember the Jedi who stopped them.

cache.win: The intercepts are good. The Empire is moving more ships than it admits.

hutt.win: The Hutt will remember this. Hutts always remember.

vault.win: Gnost-Dural reads the records twice, then asks to see the Grand Master alone.
vault.lose: Gnost-Dural says nothing on the flight home. He does not need to.

ilum.win: Jace Malcom buries four of his platoon in the snow, then asks how he can serve.
ilum.lose: The caves are silent. Malcom’s platoon held to the last.

adraasHunt.win: Satele says nothing about the treaty. She is thinking about the one Sith left.
adraasHunt.lose: The hangar smells of ozone. Adraas has gone to join Malgus.

thul.win: House Thul will speak for the Jedi at the talks.
thul.lose: Alderaan’s nobles close their doors to the Order.

depot.win: The push stalls. Somewhere, an Imperial officer is shot for it.

fort.win: The hill is Republic. For now.

dock.win: The treaty was still signed in smoke.
dock.lose: The Temple stands, scarred. Grand Master Zym walks the burned halls alone.

shard.text: Meditating again, the Council sees more: fire on the Temple steps, a red blade in a scarred hand, a treaty signed in smoke.

roles.relic: Leave a relic to the Archive

2.text: Three years go by. The war cools into a cold peace that no one trusts. Wounds heal. Padawans face the Trials. Some veterans hang up their gear.

3.text: Four more years. Envoys gather on Alderaan to sign a peace. The Council’s vision has never been clearer. Whatever is coming, it comes this year.

SHARDS.2: The vision returns: Jedi bodies on the Temple steps, and a treaty table on a green world.
SHARDS.3: The vision is clear now: a shuttle at a docking ring, a scarred Sith Lord, and the Temple doors open.

STORY_TEXT.bossWin: You stopped the shuttle. The treaty was still signed in smoke.
STORY_TEXT.bossLose: Malgus reached the Temple steps before the Guard drove him off. The Temple is scarred: a wing lost a level.
STORY_TEXT.ambush: Your ambush was ready: Malgus lands already wounded.
STORY_TEXT.adraas: Adraas fell on Alderaan: one fewer squad came with Malgus.
STORY_TEXT.guards: Temple Guards hold the docking ring: no reinforcements reach Malgus.
STORY_TEXT.eraWin: The Temple stands. The Empire got its treaty, but not its lesson.
STORY_TEXT.eraLose: The Temple stands, scarred. The Senate wonders what the Jedi are for.
STORY_TEXT.darkWarn: The Order is drifting. Some Masters speak of a Dark Council.

dock: Eleena Daru’s shuttle codes tell you exactly where he lands. You have an extra turn.
You knew this was coming. Your squad is in place early.
The Hutt sold Malgus the ring’s patrol schedule. He knows where you are.
adraasHunt: Gnost-Dural’s records name the signal Adraas is waiting for. Strike before it comes.
vault: Gnost-Dural is calm. A copy of the Archives already sleeps somewhere safe.
ilum: Some of the raiders carry Hutt-sold Ilum crystals. Your deal paid for their sabers.
envoy: The traitor names from the Imperial officer point here too.

dock: The Temple stands, scarred. The Archive copy you approved means the records survive.
Malgus fought alone at the end. Adraas never came.
ilum: Satele Shan stays behind to help Malcom bury his dead. Darach notices.
adraasHunt: Adraas is gone. Eleena’s trail still leads to Coruscant.
vault: The records match the envoy’s confession. Gnost-Dural stops sleeping.

panic: I can’t... the dark is loud.

kill: He had a family. They all do.
panic: Too many of us are hurt.

down: This isn’t how my story ends.
Huh. That’s a lot of blood.

EPILOGUE.$js: r=>`Left a relic to the Archive. Padawans still argue about what it means.`
r=>`Walks close to the dark. The Council watches ${r.n} and says nothing.`
r=>`Follows the treaty to Tython. Some say she will lead the Order one day.`
r=>`Goes back to the front. The Republic will need soldiers like him for a long time.`
r=>`Carries the war home in ${(r.scars||[]).length>1?'more than one scar':'a scar'}, and serves anyway.`
r=>`${r.kills} enemies fell to ${r.n}. The Senate gives a medal. ${r.n} gives it to the Archive.`
r=>`Takes a seat on the Council, and a Padawan of their own.`
r=>`A Knight now. Teaches the younglings what the war cost.`
r=>`Still a Padawan, still learning. Some lessons only peace can teach.`
r=>`${r.missions} missions. The Temple Guard asks for ${r.n} by name.`
r=>`Survived the war. Goes home to a planet that never knew how close it came.`

relay.brief: Imperial Sith troopers are closing on a frontier hyperspace relay. Hold it for 8 turns until the fleet arrives. Three waves are expected.
relay.goal: Hold the relay for 8 turns. The fleet is coming.
relay.win: The Republic fleet drops out of hyperspace. The relay held.
relay.lose: The relay fell. The Sith now hold the hyperlane toward the Core.

shrine.brief:
Sith troopers are raiding a kyber shrine. Pilgrims swear something else came with them: a beast that hunts Jedi. Hold for 6 turns.
The attackers left the gate, but their scouts marked a pilgrim shrine on Dantooine before they withdrew. A frightened keeper reports troops gathering at its boundary and a beast drawn to Jedi voices.
Gnost-Dural finds the shrine on an old route used by Republic couriers; the same route crosses the peace delegation’s next stop. Tor asks the squad to keep the pilgrims safe and watch what the raiders try to carry away. Hold until the evacuation is complete; soldiers can shield Jedi from the beast.
shrine.goal: Hold the shrine for 6 turns. The Terentatek can only hurt Jedi, and it devours a downed Jedi left unstabilized for a turn. Troops are your shield.
shrine.win: The pilgrims come out of hiding. The shrine stands.
shrine.lose: The shrine is looted. The pilgrims scatter.

rescue.brief:
Sith raiders hold a prisoner in a locked cell. A Medic can Hack the door from 4 tiles; a Jedi can try the console. Then walk the prisoner to an evac zone (E).
The gate is repaired enough to close, but its intercepted signals point to a prisoner transfer on Ord Mantell. Tor recognizes the transport code from the damaged vehicles left in the avenue. The prisoner may have seen who issued the order to withdraw; the convoy is already preparing to leave.
The Council asks your squad to bring that witness home before the trail reaches the peace delegation. A medic can open the cell remotely, but the rescue is complete only when the prisoner reaches the evacuation zone.
rescue.goal: Open the cell (Hack or console), then get the prisoner to an evac zone. Threat rises after turn 5; at Threat 6 they fly the prisoner out.
rescue.win: The prisoner is out. The shuttle lifts off under fire.

envoy.brief: A Republic envoy is leaking the peace-talk schedule. Scan his data terminals (Jedi or Medic, adjacent). Once 2 are copied, anyone who reaches an evac zone gets the data out. Capture him if you can.
envoy.goal: Scan 2 of 3 terminals, then get anyone to an evac zone. Threat rises after turn 6: terminals get wiped, and at Threat 6 the trail goes cold.
envoy.win: The data is out. The Council reads it that night.

archive.brief:
An Imperial post is reading Republic fleet traffic. Copy its data terminals (Jedi or Medic, adjacent), then get anyone to an evac zone. Blast walls crack under explosions.
The gate attackers withdrew with their orders, yet one damaged transmitter kept a fragment of their route. Ilsa traces it to an Imperial listening post on Balmorra, where Republic traffic has been collected for months. The post may show whether the gate assault was a diversion from the peace talks.
Gnost-Dural wants copies of the records, not a ruined terminal; fire alone will erase the proof. Scan two terminals and carry the data to extraction before the staff wipes them. The envoy investigation begins with whatever your squad brings back.
archive.goal: Scan 2 of 3 terminals, then reach an evac zone. Threat rises after turn 6: terminals get wiped. Shoot alarm beacons before they call help.
archive.win: The fleet codes are ours. Navy Intelligence owes the Order a favor.
archive.lose: The post burns its data. The trail goes cold.

sabotage.brief: The Empire fuels its Balmorra fleet from this depot. Plant charges on 2 sites (anyone, adjacent, 1 action), then get every standing squad member onto the far evac zone. The charges blow when you are clear.
sabotage.goal: Plant 2 charges (adjacent, 1 action), then get everyone still standing onto the north evac zone. Threat rises after turn 7: techs defuse an armed charge each step.
sabotage.win: The depot goes up behind you. The Balmorra fleet sits dry for a month.
sabotage.lose: The depot holds. The fleet sails on schedule.

escort.brief: Someone the Empire wants dead must reach a shuttle at the far evac zone. They take one move a turn on your phase. Keep them alive.
escort.goal: Walk the VIP to an evac zone. Threat rises after turn 6: more hunters arrive and they shoot the VIP on sight.
escort.win: The shuttle lifts off with its passenger.

archive.text: An Imperial post is reading our fleet traffic. Copy its data and get out.

sabotage.text: Blow the depot fuelling the Balmorra fleet. Plant 2 charges, then extract.

escort.text: A senator marked for death must reach a shuttle across hostile ground.

rescue.text: Sith raiders seized a Senate aide at a supply depot. The Senate wants her back.

shrine.text: Pilgrims report Sith troopers, and something that hunts Jedi, closing on a kyber shrine.
